title: Term Life Insurance Terminal Illness Accelerated Death Benefit: Tier Figures
content:
Under Term Life Insurance the terminal illness accelerated death benefit is governed by the following tier figures.

| | Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Ashgrove Level Term 10 | Ashgrove Level Term 15 | Ashgrove Level Term 20 | Ashgrove Level Term 25 | Ashgrove Level Term 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maximum acceleration share of the face amount | 0.50 (50%) | 0.75 (75%) | 0.75 (75%) | 0.75 (75%) | 0.75 (75%) | 0.75 (75%) |
| Maximum acceleration amount on one insured across all Ashgrove term policies (USD) | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 | 500000 |
| Life expectancy at or below which the insured qualifies as terminally ill | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months | 12 months |
| Acceleration administrative fee deducted from each advance (USD) | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 |
| Acceleration discount rate | 0.065 (6.5%) | 0.065 (6.5%) | 0.065 (6.5%) | 0.065 (6.5%) | 0.065 (6.5%) | 0.065 (6.5%) |
| Minimum remaining face — death benefit net of the lien that must remain (USD) | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 | 10000 |

Hypothetical reading: on an Ashgrove Level Term 20 with a face of 400000, the maximum acceleration share is 75% of the face, which is 300000; on an Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term of the same face it is 50%, which is 200000. A physician-certified life expectancy of exactly 12 months qualifies; 13 months does not.
